_provenance: Hunt B adversarial garbage scheduler. Champion = fast_rtl_x.variant("winner") + eval47/terms47.g_stranded at ws=20, root-only (ab47.py::_choose_base(wt=0,ws=20), bit-exact via reach_root.choose_base32). Pill stream = real NES stream (NesPillSource), L11. Budget = 53 halves/game, derived from BURSTY_V1_RESULTS.md Sec.5's honest v1.1 fit (champion arm measured avg garbage/game = 52.925 halves, n=120). All schedules below are clear-triggered only (a volley may only follow the champion's own clear; see adversary_search.py::bin_of) and hard-capped at the same 53-halve budget as the honest model -- no schedule below is handed more material than a human sender would produce on average. Holdout seeds 5000000-5000119 (n=120), disjoint from GA training seeds 4000000-4000015. Source: adversary/validate_only.py + adversary/validate_result.json (raw run output).

honest_baseline_v1_1_random.description: struktured-only (pool-decontaminated) bursty v1.1 fit, random column targeting -- the honest control every candidate below is compared against.

candidates.name: ga_near_spawn_a
candidates.summary: Best dies-ahead candidate found. GA-discovered fire/size shape + near_spawn column targeting (columns ranked by distance to spawn cols 3-4). Converged independently in 3 separate GA search runs this session.

candidates.name: ga_near_spawn_b
candidates.summary: Second independent GA convergence, same near_spawn targeting, slightly different fire shape (higher 4-6 bin fire prob, zero 11+ fire). Best topout candidate among the near_spawn family.

candidates.name: honest_shape_spawn_target
candidates.summary: ISOLATES THE TARGETING EFFECT: keeps the honest v1.1 model's OWN fire probabilities and volley-size mix (human-observed shape, not GA-tuned) and changes ONLY the column choice to spawn-first (cols 3,4 then rest). Achieves the exploit at the LOWEST average garbage of any candidate -- 27.2 halves, well under both the 53-halve budget and the honest baseline's own natural average of 42.35. Demonstrates the exploit is dominated by WHERE, not WHEN or HOW MUCH.

candidates.name: always_spawn_max
candidates.summary: Naive maximal heuristic: always fire (p=1.0 every bin), always max observed volley size, always spawn-column targeting. NEGATIVE CONTROL for the task's stated priority order: devastating on raw topout (95.8%, the single highest of any candidate) but WORSE than the honest baseline on dies-ahead specifically (0.8% vs 2.5%) -- it kills the champion too early/overwhelmingly (buries it outright) rather than at the doorstep-of-clearing signature the task asks to maximize FIRST. Included to show naive brute force is not the best lever for THIS specific failure mode.
